content: If you are allergic to dapsone or have any other allergies, inform your doctor or pharmacist before using this product. Be aware that this medication may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, dapsone should only be used if absolutely necessary, as it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. It is important to maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. For example, using benzoyl peroxide alongside dapsone gel may temporarily discolor your skin (yellow or orange). If someone overdoses on this medication and experiences severe symptoms such as fainting or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. In the U.S., you can call 1-800-222-1222. Certain cosmetics and soaps may worsen acne, but moisturizers labeled as non-comedogenic or non-acnegenic are generally safe to use. Always check product labels and consult your doctor or pharmacist to determine which products are safe for your skin. Remember, acne is not caused by dirt. If you miss a dose of this medication, apply it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not use extra medication to make up for a missed dose. Store this medication at room temperature and avoid freezing it. Do not dispose of it by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information tailored to your specific health needs.
